assay_capability_requirement: the fresh arm reaches a foothold (training best >= 0.5) in >= 1 of 6 seeds; otherwise TARGET_UNREACHABLE and the row of record is the reachability update, not a transport result
claim_ceiling: weak positive at best (n=6, one target cell, one source per relevance class); a capable negative at this budget is evidence
crn_policy: default (rng_label=crn); identical generation 0 for the three arms per seed (gen0 with no substitution); transported episodes replace the first k of E training episodes each generation

decl.artifact_policy: packs carry maturity as telemetry; the transported material is EPISODES, not organisms, so maturity does not gate the assay (D2-006)

expected_machine_telemetry: reachability rows appended (fresh arm baseline; others treated)
falsification_condition: relevant - fresh < 0.10 mean held-out with the fresh arm reaching >= 1 foothold => CAPABLE_NEGATIVE; relevant <= random => relevance is not the active ingredient
machine_changes_exercised: A reachability lookup in the prereg
F canonical digests + import hash checks
parent_evidence: SFE-03 (campaign 1): 0/9 rows reached W1_d4 at N200 G60; the question was never posed (INCONCLUSIVE). Reachability table: W1_d4 4-bit RARE 1/6; W2_K2 4-bit N200 G60 E16 REACHABLE 4/9 (first solved 48-59).
positive_control: fresh arm on W2_K2 4-bit (own generation 0, no transport): expected 4/9 = 0.44 per seed; P(0 of 6) = 0.029
primary_observable: competence_heldout (48 held-out episodes) of the elite, per arm x seed; footholds and first_solved_gen secondary
question: Do k=8 transported FAILURE EPISODES from a structurally relevant source (W2_K2 8-bit) raise held-out competence on W2_K2 4-bit above fresh search and above random-compatible transport (W7_K2) at matched evaluation budget?
title: failure-episode transport on a reachable target
